    <!-- ===== MAIN CONTENT ===== -->
    <main class="main-content">
      <!-- Two-column messages -->
      <div class="two-col">
        <!-- Left: Technical Program Chair message -->
        <div class="col" style="text-align: justify;">
          <h2>Welcome Message from Technical Program Chair  — IEEE AFRICON 2027</h2>

          <p>Dear Authors and Distinguished Participants,</p>

          <p>
            It is my honour to welcome you to the 2027 IEEE AFRICON Conference,
            to be held at GIMPA, Accra, Ghana. This year’s technical program
            reflects outstanding scholarship, innovation, and collaboration
            across the electrical and computer engineering disciplines, aligned
            with the theme: &ldquo;<em
              >Harnessing Emerging Technologies for Africa’s Sustainable
              Development</em
            >&rdquo;.
          </p>

          <p>
            We are pleased to announce that paper submissions are now open. We
            invite researchers from universities, industry partners, and
            research institutions across Africa and around the globe to submit
            their finest work for peer review.
          </p>

          <p>
            All submissions will undergo double-anonymous peer review by at
            least two independent reviewers. Papers accepted and presented in
            accordance with the conference presentation policy will be
            submitted to IEEE for consideration for inclusion in IEEE Xplore.
          </p>

          <p>
            We thank the reviewers, track chairs, and technical committee
            members for their diligence, professionalism, and commitment to
            maintaining high academic standards throughout the review process.
          </p>

          <p>
            We encourage you to take advantage of the technical sessions, engage
            in meaningful dialogue, and build networks that advance engineering
            research and innovation on the continent.
          </p>

          <p>
            We wish you a productive, enriching, and memorable AFRICON 2027
            experience.
          </p>

          <div class="signature">
            <strong>Ing Prof Issaka Yakubu, MIEEE</strong><br />
            Technical Program Chair<br />
            2027 IEEE AFRICON Conference
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Right: General Chair welcome -->
        <div class="col" style="text-align: justify;">
          <h2>Message from the General Chair — IEEE AFRICON 2027</h2>

          <p>
            On behalf of the Organizing Committee, I would like to welcome you
            to the 18<sup>th</sup> edition of the IEEE AFRICON 2027 Conference,
            to be held at GIMPA, Accra, Ghana, from September 23<sup>rd</sup> to
            25<sup>th</sup>, 2027. The conference theme is &ldquo;<em
              >Harnessing Emerging Technologies for Africa’s Sustainable
              Development</em
            >&rdquo;.
          </p>

          <p>
            The conference provides a platform for students, researchers, and
            industry professionals worldwide to meet, network, and pursue
            collaboration opportunities. It also serves as a forum to share
            research findings, exchange ideas, and foster innovation. Thematic
            research areas include Artificial and Computational Intelligence,
            Cloud Computing and Data Analytics, Wireless Communication Systems,
            Antennas, Microwave Systems and Propagation Models, Integrated
            Sensing &amp; Communication and IoT, Power Engineering &amp; Energy
            Systems, and Cybersecurity.
          </p>

          <p>
            The 18<sup>th</sup> edition of IEEE AFRICON 2027 continues the proud
            tradition of fostering world-class research across the continent.
            All submitted papers will undergo double-anonymous peer review by
            at least two independent reviewers, with conflicts of interest
            declared and managed by the Technical Program Committee.
          </p>

          <p>
            In addition to plenary presentations, the conference will feature
            keynote speeches and invited talks delivered by leading experts in
            electrical and computer engineering. IEEE Region 8 has also
            organized several workshops, plenary sessions, and presentations to
            provide participants with a rich and engaging technical experience.
          </p>

          <p>
            I would like to express my heartfelt appreciation for the hard work,
            dedication, and commitment of all committees, including the
            Technical Program Committee, Local Organizing Committee, Publication
            Committee, and other supporting teams, whose tireless efforts are
            essential to the success of this conference.
          </p>

          <p>
            In closing, as we work toward harnessing emerging technologies for
            Africa’s sustainable development, let us continue to explore new
            ways of advancing humanity through innovation and collaboration as a
            global research community.
          </p>

          <div class="signature">
            <strong>Dr. George Eduful, SMIEEE</strong><br />
            General Chair<br />
            IEEE AFRICON 2027
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <!-- Right: About AFRICON 2027 -->
        <div style="text-align: justify;">
          <h2>About IEEE AFRICON 2027</h2>
          <p>
            The conference will be organized under the auspices of IEEE Region 8
            and the IEEE Ghana Section. The event will be hosted
            at GIMPA, Accra, Ghana from the 23<sup>rd</sup> to 25<sup>th</sup>
            of September 2027, under the theme &ldquo;Harnessing Emerging
            Technologies for Africa&rsquo;s Sustainable Development&rdquo;.
          </p>
          <p>
            This conference will feature world-class plenary speakers, technical
            symposiums, industry and academic panels, workshops, tutorials, and
            invited tracks on emerging technologies. IEEE AFRICON 2027 is
            co-sponsored by IEEE Region 8 and the IEEE Africa Council, in
            partnership with the IEEE Ghana Section, and
            is the flagship conference for the African continent.
          </p>
          <p>
            This will be the 18<sup>th</sup> Edition of the biennial conference
            which was previously held in Nairobi, Kenya (1983), Abidjan, Ivory
            Coast (1987), Mbabane, Swaziland (1992), Stellenbosch, South Africa
            (1996), Cape Town, South Africa (1999), George, South Africa (2002),
            Gaborone, Botswana (2004), Windhoek, Namibia (2007), Nairobi, Kenya
            (2009), Livingstone, Zambia (2011), Mauritius (2013), Addis Ababa,
            Ethiopia (2015), Cape Town, South Africa (2017), Accra, Ghana
            (2019), Arusha, Tanzania (2021), Nairobi, Kenya (2023), and
            Polokwane, South Africa (2025).
          </p>
        </div>
